headline: An Agentic Playbook Hunts Bugs by Design
lede: Claude-BugHunter gives security agents a disciplined field manual for authorized testing, from reconnaissance through evidence-backed reporting. Its 83 skills and 681 vulnerability patterns turn scattered red-team knowledge into a controlled, repeatable workflow.

headline: Superpowers Makes Coding Agents Show Their Work
lede: Superpowers routes autonomous development through requirements discovery, design review, test-driven implementation, and explicit approval gates. The result is an agent workflow built less like autocomplete and more like a small engineering organization with documented handoffs.

headline: CLI-Anything Gives Software an Agent-Ready Shell
lede: CLI-Anything wraps desktop applications, games, developer tools, and services in structured command-line harnesses. With CLI-Hub handling discovery and distribution, agents gain rugged interfaces for producing real artifacts instead of merely describing them.

headline: MiniMind Builds a Language Model in Plain Sight
lede: MiniMind lays out the full construction plan for a compact language model, from tokenization and pretraining to preference optimization and serving. Its small scale makes modern model training inspectable, reproducible, and practical on a consumer GPU.

headline: Cursor Plugins Connect Agents to the Working World
lede: Cursor’s plugin catalog turns agent capabilities into installable modules for engineering, operations, sales, recruiting, and knowledge work. Consistent manifests and service integrations give teams a maintainable way to connect agents to the systems they already use.

headline: Firecrawl Turns the Live Web Into Agent Context
lede: Firecrawl handles the messy middle of web research: JavaScript rendering, crawling, proxy rotation, rate limits, and structured extraction. Its APIs and SDKs deliver pages, documents, screenshots, and JSON in forms that retrieval systems and autonomous researchers can use immediately.

headline: NGINX Keeps the Edge Fast and Unruffled
lede: NGINX moves traffic through a lean master-and-worker architecture built for serving, proxying, caching, and load balancing at scale. Text configuration, modular builds, and low resource use keep its performance profile direct and operationally legible.

headline: OpenVINO Squeezes More Inference From Intel Hardware
lede: OpenVINO converts models from major training frameworks into optimized representations for CPU, GPU, and NPU deployment. Quantization, sparsity, serving tools, and broad API support make the central question concrete: how much useful inference can the hardware deliver?

headline: Diagram Design Makes Architecture Ready to Share
lede: Diagram Design turns a plain-language brief into a polished, standalone HTML and SVG graphic. Its 44 diagram types, grid checks, brand-aware styling, and overlap detection put visual clarity inside the agent workflow rather than at the end of it.

headline: Last30Days Maps the Evidence Behind Now
lede: Last30Days assembles a recent, source-attributed brief from social platforms, news, markets, video, research, and developer communities. Parallel searches and retrieved supporting material give researchers a compact archive of what changed, who noticed, and where the evidence lives.
